name: Ashline
tagline: Lead an expedition of three heroes through fog-covered realms.
description: You explore a procedural world in pausable real time, gather wood and gold, wipe out nests and head back to the settlement to forge better gear. Combat is turn-based, winter and the night hunters keep the pressure on, and every realm ends with a boss.
coverAlt: Ashline cover art: three heroes by a campfire in the forest
